prescribedGeometry.description: Exact C4 prescribed display paths formed from two complete coaxial B1 components with opposite circulation senses; no binding or physical realization is implied.

choices: Both components use the B1 interior-reference radii and axial/transverse decompositions as a simple complete B1 fixture.
The braid centers at (0,0,-0.55) and (0,0,0.55) lie on the common z axis; equal frequencies and relative phase pi/3 complete the representative.
The opposite circulation signs are the C4 member relation; the selected first-component sign +1 is an illustrative orientation choice.
